Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 0 gallons
US COAST GUARD STATION PORT ANGELES TRAILERED A BOAT AND LAUNCHED IT INTO THE WATER. UPON MOORING THE BOAT AT THE STATION'S DOCK, A SMALL SHEEN WAS NOTICED IN THE VICINITY OF THE TRANSOM. A BOOM WAS PLACED AROUND THE VESSEL, AND ABSORBANT PADS WERE PLACED ON THE SURFACE OF THE WATER. THE CAUSE OF THE SHEEN WAS DETERMINED TO BE AN ENGINE OIL LEAK ON THE STBD OUTBOARD. THE OIL HAD LEAKED DOWN THE ENGINE ONTO THE LOWER UNIT OF THE OUTBOARD. THE RESIDUAL OIL CAUSED A SHEEN TO FORM AROUND THE ENGINE.

Nearest City: Juneau, AK

Material: DRILLING MUD (LOW TOXICITY)
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: HECLA GREENS CREEK MINING COMPANY
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 500 gallons
SPILL OF DRILLING FLUIDS (WATER, ROCK CUTTINGS, BENTONITE) TO GREENS CREEK. DRILL RIG WAS DRILLING UNCASED THROUGH BEDROCK (NORMAL PRACTICE) AND A FRACTURE WAS ENCOUNTERED AT DEPTH. THE FRACTURE ALLOWED THE ESCAPE OF THE FLUIDS INTO THE SUBSURFACE, THEN THEY FLOWED FROM THE SUBSURFACE AND DAYLIGHTED IN THE BANK OF GREENS CREEK AS SEEPS. THE SEEPS CONTINUE TO FLOW TO THE CREEK, BUT WE HAVE PLACE A PUMP IN THE CREEK AND ARE CAPTURING A MAJORITY OF THE SEEPAGE.

properties.content:
Report Details

Nearest City: Breinigsville, PA

Incident Type: MOBILE

Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party:
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 40.544852, -75.633971 (Approximated from street_address)
Report Description
///WEB REPORT/// SUSPECTED RESPONSIBLE PARTY BRINGS HOME CAR GASOLINE AND HOME FUEL OIL IN 5 GALLON CONTAINERS IN HIS PERSONAL TRUCK.. HE OFTEN TRANSPORTS 2-4 OF THESE AT A TIME WITHOUT A PERMIT TO TRANSPORT THEM. HE PARKS HIS TRUCK IN OUR PUBLIC PARKING LOT WITH ASSIGNED PARKING SPOTS. THE PARKING LOT WAS NEWLY PAVED IN MAY 2013. HIS TWO PARKING SPOTS ARE ALREADY SHOWING SIGNS OF DEGRADING FROM THE LEAKING FUEL HE CARRIES. HE ALSO FILLS HIS TRUCK AND HIS CAR AND OVER FLOWS ONTO THE ASPHALT WEEKLY. ON 08/25/2013 HE OVERFLOWED FILLING HIS CAR SO BADLY IT RAN DOWN TWO MORE PARKING SPOTS AND INTO THE PUBLIC ROADWAY. TO COVER THIS LARGE SPILL UP HE FLUSHED THE FUEL SPILL WITH WATER HE CARRIED FROM HIS HOME, WHICH ALSO RAN DOWN THE PUBLIC ROAD AND INTO THE GRASSLAND. THE ASPHALT UNDER THE SPOT OF THE SPILL HAS ERODED A HOLE 1/2" DEEP AND THE SIZE OF TWO DECKS OF PLAYING CARDS SIDE BY SIDE. IN ADDITION TO THE ASPHALT HE HAD LEAKAGE INTO THE GROUND SOIL DIRECTLY WHERE HE STORES THE 5 GALLON CONTAINERS THAT ARE NOT MARKED OR PLAGUED IN ANYWAY. HE FILLS THESE CONTAINERS UP AT WORK FROM THE LARGE STORAGE PUMPS AND TRANSPORTS THEM. THE LEAKAGE OCCURS IN THE TRUCK BED, IN THE TRANSPORT PATH FROM HIS TRUCK BED TO THE PLACE HE STORES IT IN A WOODED AREA BEHIND HIS TRAILER, OUT IN THE OPEN. THE CONTAINERS ARE NOT CONTAINED IN ANY POND, SO IF THEY LEAKED, THEY WOULD DRAIN DIRECTLY INTO THE DIRT AND SURROUNDING NEIGHBOR'S LAND. THE OTHER NEIGHBORS HAVE NOT COMPLAINED BECAUSE HE SELLS THIS GAS AND FUEL OIL FOR $2.00 TO THEM AND THAT IS A LOT CHEAPER THAN THE MARKET PRICE OF GAS OR FUEL OIL.

Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTING THEY WERE HIRED TO DO ELECTRICAL WORK ON A 65 FT HATTERA YACHT. THEY STARTED WORKING IN THE ENGINE ROOM AND SMELLED DIESEL THROUGHOUT THE VESSEL. WHILE WORKING ON THE VESSEL, CALLER STATED A LARGE SLICK SURFACED ON THE WATER AND OTHER CITIZENS CONFIRMED THE SHEEN. CALLER NOTED THE DIESEL LEAKED INTO THE HULL, UNDERNEATH FLOOR PANELS AND INTO WATERWAY OVER THE COURSE OF 6-8 DAYS WITH OUT BEING REPORTED. THE CAUSE WAS FOUND TO BE A LEAK FROM A WORN FILLER PIPE DUE TO WEAR AND TEAR. SRP PAID A 3RD PARTY TO REPAIR VESSEL AND COLLECT RESIDUAL DIESEL IN THE VESSEL WITHOUT REPORTING. CALLER WAS INSTRUCTED TO ASSIST IN THIS PROCESS. THE 3RD PARTY VACUUMED DIESEL FROM AFFECTED AREA, WITH A SHOP VAC, AND DISPOSED THE RESIDUAL OIL INTO EMPTY "TIDE" BRAND DETERGENT BOTTLES. CALLER STATED MOST CLEAN UP AND REPAIR OCCURRED UNDER COVER OF NIGHT.
